title: Decoding a block followed by a suffix
statement: Let $b,D$ be natural numbers, let $e$ be a bijection from the Boolean strings of length $b$ to the indices $0,\ldots,D-1$, let $k$ be a natural number, let $u$ be a Boolean string of length $b$, and let $l$ be any finite Boolean string. Decoding $k+1$ blocks from the concatenation of $u$ and $l$ gives first the index $e(u)$, followed by the result of decoding $k$ blocks from $l$.
hypotheses_covered: $u$ is a Boolean string indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}\,b$
